description:
Every answer relates to a place.

Relatable is a word game about the cities of the UK. Pick a city, read the clue, and unscramble the letters before the clock runs out. In Nottingham the answers might be SHERWOOD or GOOSE FAIR. In Edinburgh, HOGMANAY or AULD REEKIE. In Liverpool, SCOUSE or the THREE GRACES.

22 CITIES, 2,200 LEVELS
London, Nottingham, York, Liverpool, Edinburgh, Manchester, Bristol, Cardiff, Birmingham, Newcastle, Glasgow, Leeds, Sheffield, Belfast, Brighton, Oxford, Bath and Leicester, and new: Cambridge, Norwich, Aberdeen and Swansea. Each city has 100 levels of folklore, history, landmarks, food and local dialect.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
The daily puzzle picks a conundrum from all the cities at midnight, UK time. It costs no lives and builds a streak, and every seven days in a row earns a streak freeze to cover a missed day. Share your result without giving the answer away, set a daily reminder, and add the widget to your Home Screen or Lock Screen.

TIME ATTACK
Two minutes to solve as many anagrams as you can. Skip the ones that stump you, top the Game Center leaderboard, and challenge your friends to beat your score.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
Every answer comes with a fact about the place, from Roman baths to the Rhubarb Triangle. Each city keeps the facts you've found in its own fact file.

GETS HARDER AS YOU GO
Levels start with short, familiar words and build to long, obscure ones. The clock gets tighter too, from 60 seconds on Easy to 45 on Expert. Solve with half the time left and no hints for three stars, and replay any level you've solved to go back for more.

THREE LIVES, HINTS AND SHUFFLES
Run out of time and you lose a life. Lost lives come back every day at midnight. Each hint drops one correct letter into place, and Shuffle gives you a fresh look at the letters.

CATCH UP WITH THE ARCHIVE
The Every City Pass includes the daily archive: the last 30 daily puzzles, ready to play whenever you like.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with keyboard play on iPad
• The daily puzzle on Apple Watch
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Play today's Relatable"
• A Control Centre button for the daily puzzle
• Game Center leaderboards, achievements and challenges
• Stars and streaks sync across your devices with iCloud
• Works with VoiceOver and Reduce Motion
• Light or dark, original music and sound effects

FAIR AND SIMPLE
London, Nottingham, the daily puzzle and Time Attack come with the game. Unlock other cities one at a time, or all at once with the Every City Pass, which includes any cities added later. Purchases work with Family Sharing. No adverts, no subscriptions, no account needed, and no personal data collected.

Relatable is an independent game and isn't affiliated with any TV programme, broadcaster, council or tourist board.
promotionalText: New: Cambridge, Norwich, Aberdeen and Swansea, two-minute Time Attack, streak freezes and the daily puzzle on Apple Watch. 2,200 anagrams from London to Aberdeen.
notes:
Relatable is an anagram game. No account or sign-in is needed.

ABOUT THE PREVIOUS REJECTION (2.3.7): every screenshot has been retaken. None now shows prices, price tags or the word "free".

London, Nottingham, the daily puzzle and Time Attack need no purchase. The other 20 cities unlock with in-app purchases, one at a time or all together with the Every City Pass, which also unlocks the daily archive. Cities and the pass support Family Sharing. Hints and a lives refill are consumables. The Shop opens from the bulb (hints) button on the home screen, the "Unlock every city" button at the bottom of the home screen, or any locked city. Restore purchases is in Settings and in the Shop. Promoted in-app purchases are handled by the app.

NEW IN 2.0
- Four new cities: Cambridge, Norwich, Aberdeen and Swansea.
- Time Attack (home screen): two minutes to solve as many anagrams as possible from unlocked cities. Costs no lives. Scores go to a Game Center leaderboard; on iOS 26 "Challenge friends" uses a Game Center challenge.
- Daily archive (home screen): the last 30 daily puzzles. It needs the Every City Pass; in the sandbox, buy the pass from the Shop to test it. Archive puzzles don't change the streak.
- Streak freezes: earned every 7 days in a row (maximum 2), used automatically on a missed day.
- Daily puzzle reminder: Settings > Reminders. A local notification at a chosen time, off by default.
- Fact file: on each city's level screen, listing facts for solved levels.
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Play today's Relatable", "Start Relatable Time Attack", "What's my Relatable streak". A Control Centre control opens the daily puzzle.
- Apple Watch app: today's daily puzzle (same as on iPhone), synced through iCloud key-value storage.
- Game Center activities for the daily puzzle and Time Attack.
- Hardware keyboard play on iPad: type letters, Delete, Space to shuffle, Escape to clear.

Lives: running out of time on an unsolved level costs one of three lives. Replays of solved levels, the daily puzzle and Time Attack never cost lives. Lives refill at midnight UK time. So that players can't get free lives or skip ahead in the daily puzzle by changing the device clock, the app reads the current time from the Date header of a HEAD request to apple.com (falling back to google.com and cloudflare.com). No personal data is sent.

To see the out-of-lives screen quickly, let the clock run out on three unsolved levels.

All music and sound effects are original and were made for this app.
